description: This is a minified JavaScript source file that contains the Bootstrap v3.3.5 library code. It defines various UI components such as alerts, buttons, carousels, modals, tooltips, popovers, scrollspy, tabs, and affix behavior, along with support for transitions and other bootstrap functionalities.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Handles alert dismissible UI component with transition support.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Enables button toggling with loading state support.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Handles collapsing and expanding of elements with animation.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Provides modal dialog UI component with show/hide, backdrop, and transition support.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Adds tooltip hover/focus overlays to elements.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: Provides popover overlays similar to tooltips with additional content support.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Tracks scrolling position to update navigation links.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Enables fixed positioning based on scroll thresholds.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates transition end event after a specified duration.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles visibility of UI components like collapse or modal.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays modal, tooltip, or similar component.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides modal, tooltip, or similar component.

methods.name: activate(b,d,e)
methods.description: Activates navigation links or tab content.
